_about: Named close-ups of the breadboard for the BRIO in its fixed mount (baseline 2026-09-13). 'at' is the spot in the zoom-100 frame the view is aimed at.

MEASURED: a zoom-Z crop is centred at x = 960 + (pan/36000)*960*(1-100/Z), y = 540 - (tilt/36000)*540*(1-100/Z) in the 1920x1080 zoom-100 frame; pan and tilt step by 3600. Checked by locating four calibration crops in the whole frame, each within a pixel.
If the camera is moved, these are wrong: re-take the board frame, re-aim, and cut a new baseline.
